claims.claim: NVIDIA entered multiyear strategic agreements with Lumentum in March 2026, including a multibillion purchase commitment and $2B investment tied to advanced optics capacity and R&D.
Lumentum is adding a 240,000-square-foot North Carolina InP facility for AI-data-center lasers, with production expected to ramp in mid-2028.

factors.name: Strategic customer validation
factors.basis: Purchase commitment, equity investment and capacity-access agreement validate optical bottleneck relevance.

risks.risk: Large capacity investments create execution and utilization risk before the mid-2028 ramp.

causalEdges.mechanism: higher bandwidth and power constraints increase optical connectivity requirements
causalEdges.falsifier: architectures reduce optical intensity or competing suppliers capture committed volumes

unknowns.unknown: Latest fiscal execution is not used in this object; Council Alpha should pair this strategic evidence with current financials.

claims.claim: The NVIDIA commitment and planned Greensboro fab create explicit future delivery milestones, but the new fab is not expected to ramp until mid-2028, separating strategic validation from near-term execution proof.

factors.name: Execution milestone clarity
factors.basis: Customer commitment is strong, while meaningful new-fab capacity remains a future execution event.

risks.risk: Schedule, yield, capex and customer-architecture changes can impair expected fab economics before ramp.

causalEdges.mechanism: purchase commitments support investment in additional InP supply
causalEdges.falsifier: commitments are revised or fab ramp materially slips

unknowns.unknown: Current valuation and latest quarter execution are not asserted here.
